title: Generate Parentheses
statement_short: Given n pairs of parentheses, write a function to generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses.
hint: n up to 8 indicates generating Catalans-number combinations of valid open/close bracket choices recursively.
why_not: Right: Backtracking places open and close brackets recursively while open_count <= n and close_count < open_count in O(4^n / sqrt(n)) time. Not Stack: Stack validates parenthesis strings, but generating all valid combinations requires path backtracking. Not 1D DP: DP counts valid parentheses or builds strings from subproblems, but recursive branch pruning is the standard pattern. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointer pairs evaluate fixed array subsegments rather than building valid parenthesis strings.
